<title level="1" right="Action">[Spring Kick](/Actions.aspx?ID=2784) <actions string="Two Actions" /></title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 91

</column>

---

The kangaroo balances on its tail and lashes out with a powerful two-legged kick. The kangaroo makes a foot Strike. If it hits, the target is pushed back 10 feet. On a critical hit, they are also knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88).
